    Definitions & method
    LeadOne submission row in PARTNERS_LEADS, dated by PARTNER_STACK_LEAD_SUBMISSION_DATE.
    Qualified outLEAD_STATUS = 'Disqualified' — rejected at partner-lead review, before any opportunity exists.
    PendingNeither qualified out nor yet an SQA. Still open at the lead stage.
    SQALead reached an active opportunity — ACTIVE_OPP_CREATED_DATE is populated.
    Open pipeHas an opportunity that is not yet Closed Won or Closed Lost.
    Closed Won / Closed LostSTAGE_NAME on the linked opportunity.
    SQA rate / CW rateSQA (or Closed Won) divided by leads submitted in that group.
    Median daysMidpoint elapsed time for leads that completed that step. Excludes leads with missing or out-of-order dates, so counts can sit slightly below the cohort totals.
    Funnel joinLead to opportunity matched on PARTNER_STACK_LEAD_KEY, falling back to account + partner + submission date where the key is null (about a quarter of rows).
    Period comparisonsQuarter-to-date uses the same number of elapsed days in each comparison quarter.
